content.short: Immunefi is the leading Web3 bug bounty platform connecting projects with white-hat hackers to secure protocols.
content.description: Immunefi is the premier bug bounty and security coordination platform for the Web3 ecosystem, dedicated to protecting decentralized protocols. By connecting projects with a global community of elite white-hat hackers, the platform facilitates the identification of critical vulnerabilities in exchange for rewards. This collaborative approach has successfully prevented billions of dollars in potential hacks. In addition to bug bounties, Immunefi offers advanced security operations and coordinates community-driven security to ensure a safer and more resilient future for Web3.
content.meta: Immunefi provides the top bug bounty platform in Web3 for protocol security. Discover Immunefi and other Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
